utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep — it’s Saturday at 9:00 AM at Mara’s porch. I’ll pass that along and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll remind folks to bring tools, screws, and spare paint. If the tools pile gets messy, Ira can help sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll keep sharing those details and let folks know to bring tools, screws, and spare paint.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Opal — I’ll keep everyone posted. And please thank Quinn for helping spread the word, too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll thank Quinn. Also, Jules is the one spreading the word, and Mara’s helping at the porch on Saturday at 9:00 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, then let’s have Rey set up the tables and remind everyone to bring tools, screws, and spare paint. Oren can help sort the tools, and the repair drive is still Saturday at 9:00 AM.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll ask around and round up a couple more people if you still need hands. If you can give me a quick rundown of anything else that’s left, I’ll help cover it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that’s helpful. Just keep the time as Saturday at 9:00 AM and let me know if you find anyone else who can pitch in.

utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — if you can grab a few tools or drop off spare parts, that’d help a lot. Keep me posted if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out to grab supplies for the repair drive, and I can sort the tools when I’m back. Once the details are set, Jules can line up volunteers and Dane can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — I’ll pick up the supplies and sort the tools when I’m back. Once you have the drop-off hours, send them over and I’ll help keep folks in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — I could really use your help with the repair drive. If you can set up the tables and remind folks to bring tools, screws, and spare paint, I’ll sort the tools when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll set up the tables and remind folks to bring tools, screws, and any spare paint. I’ll also bring what I can for the event.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s great, Rey — thanks a lot. I’ll sort the tools when they come in, and we should be all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Gus — that covers a lot. I’ll make the quick list and bring the extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Faye — Saturday at 9:00 AM still works, and I’ll keep the list tight around the school schedule. I’ll be on the porch after 5 for Quinn’s tools if he can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to pin down the drop-off timing for Saturday at 9:00 AM, and whether we need to label anything first. If you hear anything, please let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — I’ll keep you posted, and I’m starting a quick list of broken items so we can match each one with a neighbor who can help fix it. For now, let’s plan on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I think Saturday at 9:00 AM is still the current plan, so let’s hold off on Sunday for now. If you learn the drop-off window or any label instructions, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and help coordinate tools or rides for anyone who needs them. Send me the exact details when you have them, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — once you send the date, time, and location, I’ll help spread the word. And Oren’s handling the tools, so just send me the details first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday at 9:00 AM works for the repair drive. Rey can set up the tables and remind folks to bring tools, screws, and spare paint.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren wants help too, and he can sort the tools. Is there anything else you need for Saturday at 9:00 AM?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive. And I really appreciate Quinn’s help with it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, Saturday works for me too. And if Gus’s drill is ready, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, I’ll let everyone know Saturday works, and I’ll check on Gus’s drill too. Thanks, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa’s organizing the repair drive and keeping everyone posted. If folks can bring tools, screws, and spare paint, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks—I've got some spare tools I can bring. If you still need it, I could also help out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Oren—could you help sort the tools when you get here? We’re still looking for tools, screws, and spare paint too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors, and I’ll swing by Mara’s porch after 5 with the spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Quinn — thank you. I can help connect anyone who still needs tools or a ride for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep telling folks about Saturday’s repair drive, and I’ll bring the spare tools by Mara’s porch after 5.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still set for Saturday at 9:00 AM, and Mara’s helping out. I’m also checking on drop-off hours and will let Mina and Pia know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll pass that along and spread the word. If Hana needs the exact details, I can check them too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be perfect, thanks — and if you hear back on the drop-off hours, send them my way so I can pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to pin down the drop-off timing, and I don’t want to show up early if the hours aren’t set yet. If anything needs labels first, please let me know.

utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Pia — I’ll let you know if labels are needed first. I’m checking the timing and will share it as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’ll wait for the timing, and I’m keeping an eye on whether anything needs labels first.

utterances.text: Opal: It’s set for Saturday at 9:00 AM on Mara’s porch. Sam, Jules, Mara, Rosa, Quinn, Faye, and Noah are all helping in their own ways.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Uh, I’m not totally sure I caught all the details—could you remind me what’s being repaired and when the drive is?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s the repair drive on Saturday at 9:00 AM at Mara’s porch. Folks can bring in things that need fixing, and the helpers will sort the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can round up a couple more people—could you give me the quick rundown on what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need the tools sorted and a few workstations set up. Oren’s helping with the sorting and one workstation, and I’m keeping folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll round up a couple more people and ask around if we need any extra supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m getting a quick list of broken items started and matching each one with a neighbor who can help fix it. I’ll keep everyone posted as we get Sunday’s repair drive organized at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll be there to help with the repair drive and keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — that’s a big help. I’ll keep the list moving, and we’ll have Sunday’s repair drive ready at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out to grab supplies for the repair drive, and I can help sort the tools when I’m back. If you need the exact details passed along, Dane can check with Hana and share them once he has them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, just to confirm—Rosa’s still the one organizing the repair drive, yes? And if we need extra hands, Bo, Sam, and Quinn are the ones to ask?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, Rosa’s still organizing it. And yes, Bo, Sam, and Quinn are the ones to ask if we need extra hands.
